definition: Lovescape is a companion platform for artificial intelligence (AI) that lets users create and engage with customisable virtual characters via text chats and AI-generated graphics, music, and video.
details: Lovescape gained media attention in 2026 after a marketing campaign including AI-generated content made it a trending topic on X. The company said it utilizes moderation mechanisms to enforce its regulations and that it forbids content involving minors, non-consensual material, and unauthorized portrayals of actual individuals.

explainer.lead: Lovescape is a companion platform where users build and chat with customizable virtual characters, with AI-generated graphics, music, and video. Its 2026 marketing campaign made it a trending topic on X.

tiers.eli5: It's like an app where you design your own imaginary friend, talk with them, and get pictures and songs made for you.
tiers.practitioner: Builders of companion apps face content-moderation and safety requirements alongside generation features. A pitfall is underestimating moderation load when users create open-ended characters.
tiers.paperLevel: A consumer AI companion application offering customizable virtual characters through text chat and generated multimedia; the company states it uses moderation mechanisms forbidding content involving minors, non-consensual material, and unauthorized portrayals of actual individuals.

explainer.example: A user creates a character, chats with it by text, and receives AI-generated artwork and music for that character.
